mapper.select: SELECT vote_id, meeting_id, participant_id, candidate_id, vote_change_count, created_at, updated_at FROM place_votes WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND participant_id = #{participantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_votes ( meeting_id, participant_id, candidate_id, vote_change_count ) VALUES ( #{meetingId}, #{participantId}, #{candidateId}, #{voteChangeCount} )
mapper.select:
SELECT mc.candidate_id AS candidateId, mc.place_name AS placeName, COUNT(pv.vote_id) AS voteCount FROM meeting_candidates mc
LEFT JOIN place_votes pv ON mc.candidate_id = pv.candidate_id AND pv.meeting_id = #{meetingId}
WHERE mc.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND mc.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY mc.candidate_id, mc.place_name
ORDER BY voteCount DESC, mc.candidate_id ASC
